function.name: is_valid_ColorAdjustType
function.description: This function checks if the given ColorAdjustType is within the valid range.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: This parameter represents the type of color adjustment.

function.return_type: int, returns 1 if the ColorAdjustType is within the valid range, otherwise returns 0.

function.name: GdipCloneImageAttributes
function.description: This function clones the image attributes from a source to a destination. It also handles memory allocation and error checking for the cloning process.

parameters.name: imageattr
parameters.description: This is the source image attributes that will be cloned.

parameters.name: cloneImageattr
parameters.description: This is the destination where the cloned image attributes will be stored.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns 'Ok'. If the parameters are invalid, it returns 'InvalidParameter'. If there is a memory allocation error, it returns 'OutOfMemory'.

function.name: GdipCreateImageAttributes
function.description: This function creates image attributes, sets the wrap mode to WrapModeClamp, and returns the status of the operation.

parameters.name: imageattr
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a GpImageAttributes structure. This structure will be allocated and initialized within the function.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. It can return InvalidParameter if the input parameter is null, OutOfMemory if memory allocation fails, or Ok if the operation is successful.

function.name: GdipDisposeImageAttributes
function.description: This function disposes of the resources associated with an image attributes object, including freeing the color map tables and the image attributes object itself.

parameters.name: imageattr
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the image attributes object to be disposed.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. It returns 'InvalidParameter' if the input is null, otherwise it returns 'Ok' after successfully freeing the resources.

function.name: GdipGetImageAttributesAdjustedPalette
function.description: This function adjusts the palette of an image according to the specified image attributes and color adjustment type.

parameters.name: imageattr
parameters.description: Pointer to the image attributes to be applied.

parameters.name: palette
parameters.description: Pointer to the palette to be adjusted.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of color adjustment to be applied.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if any of the parameters are invalid.

function.name: GdipSetImageAttributesColorKeys
function.description: This function sets the color keys for an image attribute. It checks if the image attribute and color adjust type are valid, then sets the color keys accordingly.

parameters.name: imageattr
parameters.description: Pointer to the image attributes

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of color adjustment

parameters.name: enableFlag
parameters.description: Flag to enable or disable the color keys

parameters.name: colorLow
parameters.description: Lower limit of the color key range

parameters.name: colorHigh
parameters.description: Upper limit of the color key range

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the parameters are not valid

function.name: GdipSetImageAttributesColorMatrix
function.description: This function sets the color and gray matrices for an image attribute object. If the enableFlag is true, it also sets the color matrix and flags for the specified type. If the flag is ColorMatrixFlagsAltGray, it also sets the gray matrix. Finally, it sets the enable flag for the specified type.

parameters.name: imageattr
parameters.description: A pointer to the image attribute object to be modified.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of adjustment to be made.

parameters.name: enableFlag
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether the color matrix should be enabled.

parameters.name: colorMatrix
parameters.description: A pointer to the color matrix to be set.

parameters.name: grayMatrix
parameters.description: A pointer to the gray matrix to be set if the flag is ColorMatrixFlagsAltGray.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags indicating the type of color matrix to be set.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if any parameter is invalid.

function.name: GdipSetImageAttributesWrapMode
function.description: This function sets the wrap mode, outside color, and clamp value of an image attribute.

parameters.name: imageAttr
parameters.description: Pointer to the image attribute to be modified.

parameters.name: wrap
parameters.description: The wrap mode to be set.

parameters.name: argb
parameters.description: The outside color to be set.

parameters.name: clamp
parameters.description: The clamp value to be set.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the parameters are not valid.

function.name: GdipSetImageAttributesCachedBackground
function.description: This function is used to set image attributes for a cached background. However, it is currently not implemented.

parameters.name: imageAttr
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the image attributes to be set.

parameters.name: enableFlag
parameters.description: This flag is used to enable or disable the setting of image attributes.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. Currently, it always returns 'NotImplemented'.

function.name: GdipSetImageAttributesGamma
function.description: This function sets the gamma value for an image attribute and enables or disables gamma correction.

parameters.name: imageAttr
parameters.description: Pointer to the image attribute object

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Specifies the type of adjustment

parameters.name: enableFlag
parameters.description: Flag to enable or disable gamma correction

parameters.name: gamma
parameters.description: The gamma value to be set

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if parameters are not valid

function.name: GdipSetImageAttributesNoOp
function.description: This function sets the no-operation status of an image attribute, based on the color adjust type and a boolean flag.

parameters.name: imageAttr
parameters.description: Pointer to the image attribute to be modified.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The color adjust type to be checked and set.

parameters.name: enableFlag
parameters.description: Flag to determine whether to set or clear the no-operation status.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if the color adjust type is invalid.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of color adjustment

parameters.name: enableFlag

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of color adjustment

parameters.name: enableFlag
parameters.description: Flag to enable or disable the color profile

parameters.name: colorProfileFilename
parameters.description: Filename of the color profile

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation, but currently always returns 'NotImplemented'

function.name: GdipSetImageAttributesRemapTable
function.description: This function sets the color remap table for specified image attributes. If the enable flag is true, it creates a new color map with the specified size, copies the input map to the new map, and assigns it to the image attributes. If the enable flag is false, it frees the existing color map and sets it to NULL. The function also sets the enable flag in the image attributes.

parameters.name: imageAttr
parameters.description: Pointer to the image attributes to be modified.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Specifies the type of adjustment to be made.

parameters.name: enableFlag
parameters.description: Flag to enable or disable the color remap table.

parameters.name: mapSize
parameters.description: Size of the color map.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: Pointer to the color map to be copied.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'Ok' if successful, 'InvalidParameter' if input parameters are not valid, and 'OutOfMemory' if memory allocation fails.

function.return_type: GpStatus, which represents the status of the operation. However, since the function is not implemented, it always returns 'NotImplemented'.

function.name: GdipResetImageAttributes
function.description: This function resets the image attributes and sets the color keys, remap table, gamma, and noop for the specified color adjust type.

parameters.name: imageAttr
parameters.description: A pointer to the image attributes to be reset.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The color adjust type for which the image attributes are to be reset.

function.return_type: GpStatus, represents the status of the operation. Returns 'InvalidParameter' if the imageAttr pointer is null or the ColorAdjustType is invalid, otherwise returns 'Ok'.
